binary: Locally modified, pinned-source Win32 Workflow build
scope: Game-local DirectInput 1-7 to 8 adapter, joystick ON by default unless saved OFF. Local DX7 policy exposes at most 31 buttons and omits excess buttons without remapping; legacy buffered records are size-converted. No driver or virtual device is installed. Physical controller and force-feedback coverage remains limited.

localBuild.toolset: MSVC v143 14.42.34433; Win32 Workflow; static runtime; /Brepro; /OPT:NOICF
